name: 7Seas Entertainment Limited
about: 7Seas Entertainment Limited engages in the development and publishing of digital games and interactive content in India. The company offers mobile and personal-computer and online environments, such as casual, arcade, racing, shooting, action, puzzle, and simulation games. It also provides consultancy, software development, and IT Infrastructure solutions to clients and partners. The company was formerly known as 7Seas Technologies Limited. 7Seas Entertainment Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
